description: Data for Welsh 2016 half-hourly building energy consumption profiles for domestic and non-domestic buildings by 2011 census output area. Split by local authority areas is a data set deposited in Cardiff University by its authors Simon Lannon, Ian Knight. These estimated Half Hourly data profiles for all the Local Authorities in Wales for the Calendar Year 2016 were derived by the Authors as part of the Institute of Welsh Affairs 'Re-energizing Wales' Project in 2017. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 26336853355 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
